gloss: returning to school; resuming one's studies

definitions.gloss: returning to school; resuming one's studies
definitions.explanation: Going back to school or university after a period of absence, such as a leave of absence, illness, or suspension.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来学期|らいがっき}→来学期：27523_raigakki⟧{復学|ふくがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I plan to return to school next semester.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}った→治る：19598_naoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{復学|ふくがく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I returned to school after recovering from my illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休学|きゅうがく}→休学：05140_kyuugaku⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、{復学|ふくがく}{届|とどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When the leave of absence ends, you need to submit a return-to-school notification.

notes:
Used in academic and administrative contexts for students who return to their studies after a formal absence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {復学|ふくがく}{届|とどけ}: notification of return to school
- {復学|ふくがく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: procedures for returning to school
- {復学|ふくがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許可|きょか}する→許可する：20063_kyokasuru⟧: to permit return to school
- {復学|ふくがく}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after returning to school

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{休学|きゅうがく}→休学：05140_kyuugaku⟧: leave of absence (from school) — the opposite action
- ⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧: dropping out, withdrawal
- ⟦{編入|へんにゅう}→編入：13887_hennyuu⟧: transfer (to another school)
- ⟦{復職|ふくしょく}→復職：15398_fukushoku⟧: returning to work — the workplace equivalent

FORMS:
{復|ふく} (return, restore) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study, school). Parallel to ⟦{復職|ふくしょく}→復職：15398_fukushoku⟧ (returning to work) and ⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧ (returning/comeback).
